overview: The Commission accepted a new demolition application for 18 Cherry Street and reviewed renovation designs for the Riverside Avenue Plaza. Several items were tabled due to the lack of a full quorum, while updates were provided on ongoing cemetery preservation and community survey projects.

items.title: 38 Pearl Street Demolition Delay
items.summary: Tabled the vote to lift the demolition delay because a member's recusal left the Commission without a quorum for the item.

items.title: 18 Wedgmere Road
items.summary: Closed the matter after the applicant officially withdrew their demolition request.

items.title: 18 Cherry Street Demolition Application
items.summary: Accepted the demolition application and scheduled a significance hearing for the following month.

items.title: 56 Wareham Street Demolition Mitigation
items.summary: Reviewed revised plans for a modern addition; the Commission requested more clarification on building massing and window placement before taking a final vote.

items.title: Riverside Avenue Plaza Renovations
items.summary: Supported a grant application for plaza improvements including new shade sails and a floating deck designed to protect mature oak trees.

items.title: Hegner Center / Ralph L. Kendall Fieldhouse
items.summary: Agreed to issue a letter of significance for the building to support a Community Preservation Act grant application for roof, window, and door repairs.

items.title: Cemetery and Survey Updates
items.summary: Received updates on stone wall maintenance at Thomas Brooks Park, the re-bidding of archaeological work at Cross Street Cemetery, and the completion of the Fulton Heights survey project.

items.title: Administrative Business and Form B Orders
items.summary: Approved $2,500 to fund five new property inventory forms and discussed future networking events with the Medford Historical Society.
